_metadata.safety_declaration: All doctors, qualifications, experience, consulting rooms, schedules, and clinical department records in this file are simulated demo entries strictly for academic evaluation. No real medical practitioner, patient, or real-world clinical record is represented.

hospital_profile.name: EgleSora Hospital
hospital_profile.tagline: Healthcare Simulation & Clinical Care Demonstration | Final-Year Project
hospital_profile.overview: EgleSora Hospital Platform is an academic healthcare demonstration system developed for final-year engineering internship evaluation. The portal simulates modern clinical governance, specialized department workflows, attending physician schedules, and digital appointment booking for the Yavatmal district in Maharashtra.
hospital_profile.address: Civil Lines Road, Near GMC Campus, Yavatmal, Maharashtra 445001
hospital_profile.emergency_info: [ACADEMIC DEMO NOTICE] This portal is an educational demonstration project. In case of an actual medical emergency, please dial 108 or contact your nearest government medical college & hospital.

specialties.name: General Medicine
specialties.description: Comprehensive primary medical care, adult fever triage, and chronic lifestyle disease management.

specialties.name: Cardiology
specialties.description: Comprehensive diagnostic, preventive, and clinical cardiovascular medicine.

specialties.name: Orthopaedics
specialties.description: Musculoskeletal health, joint care, fracture triage, and mobility rehabilitation.

specialties.name: Paediatrics & Child Health
specialties.description: General and preventive healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents.

specialties.name: Neurology & Neuro-Care
specialties.description: Comprehensive stroke management, headache disorders, and neuromuscular medical care.

specialties.name: Otolaryngology (ENT)
specialties.description: Medical and surgical diagnosis of ear, nose, throat, voice, and sinus conditions.

specialties.name: Dermatology & Skin Care
specialties.description: Clinical diagnosis of dermatological conditions, allergic eczema, and hair disorders.

departments.name: Department of General Medicine
departments.short_description: Comprehensive primary adult medical care, diagnostic evaluation, fever triage, and chronic illness management.
departments.full_description: The Department of General Medicine provides diagnostic and therapeutic care for common and complex adult medical conditions, seasonal fevers, hypertension, and diabetes management.
departments.location: Wing A, Ground Floor, OPD Suites 101-105

services.name: Comprehensive Adult Health Checkup
services.description: Routine diagnostic clinical evaluation and vital assessment.

services.name: Diabetic & Hypertension Triage
services.description: Metabolic monitoring and preventive lifestyle health guidance.

faqs.question: Is prior fasting required for a routine general consultation?
faqs.answer: Routine general consultation does not require fasting unless fasting blood sugar or lipid tests are scheduled.

departments.name: Department of Cardiovascular Sciences
departments.short_description: Comprehensive non-invasive cardiovascular diagnostics, preventative cardiology, and cardiac monitoring.
departments.full_description: The Department of Cardiovascular Sciences offers high-precision cardiac diagnostics including 2D Echocardiography, Treadmill Stress Testing (TMT), and ambulatory blood pressure monitoring for heart wellness.

services.name: 2D Transthoracic Echocardiography
services.description: High-resolution cardiac ultrasound imaging for chamber and valve assessment.

services.name: Treadmill Stress Test (TMT)
services.description: Cardiovascular exercise tolerance and ischemic monitoring.

faqs.question: What medical records should I bring for a cardiology appointment?
faqs.answer: Please carry previous ECG records, discharge summaries, and ongoing prescription medicines for clinical review.

departments.name: Department of Orthopaedics & Joint Care
departments.short_description: Evaluation of joint disorders, fracture healing, back pain, and musculoskeletal rehabilitation.
departments.full_description: The Department of Orthopaedics delivers outpatient consultations for joint arthritis management, sports injury rehabilitation, fracture care, and spine health.

services.name: Digital Musculoskeletal X-Ray Assessment
services.description: High-resolution digital radiography for bone and joint evaluation.

services.name: Joint Injections & Plaster Care
services.description: Conservative joint pain therapy and immobilisation casting.

faqs.question: Are wheelchair facilities available at the OPD reception?
faqs.answer: Yes, wheelchair and assisted mobility support are available at the entrance and Wing C desk.

departments.name: Department of Paediatrics & Child Health
departments.short_description: Infant care, child growth monitoring, national immunisation, and pediatric wellness.
departments.full_description: Dedicated child-friendly outpatient care focusing on newborn growth monitoring, childhood nutrition, vaccination programs, and pediatric recovery.

services.name: Child Immunisation Program
services.description: Vaccination and scheduled booster immunization according to national health standards.

services.name: Pediatric Growth & Developmental Screening
services.description: Holistic developmental milestones evaluation for infants and toddlers.

faqs.question: Should I bring the child's immunization booklet?
faqs.answer: Yes, always carry the government or hospital vaccination record booklet for every visit.

departments.name: Department of Neurosciences & Stroke Care
departments.short_description: Diagnostic evaluation of stroke risk, persistent migraines, epilepsy, and neuromuscular conditions.
departments.full_description: The Department of Neurosciences delivers specialized outpatient clinical evaluation for headache syndromes, movement disorders, peripheral neuropathy, and post-stroke recovery management.

services.name: Neurological Clinical Assessment
services.description: Detailed cranial nerve, motor reflex, and sensory nerve clinical examination.

services.name: Migraine & Headache Triage
services.description: Evidence-based therapeutic management of chronic headaches.

faqs.question: Can I consult for chronic dizziness or balance issues?
faqs.answer: Yes, our neuro-assessment includes vestibular and cerebellar clinical evaluation.

departments.name: Department of ENT & Head-Neck Care
departments.short_description: Diagnostic management of hearing difficulties, allergic sinusitis, throat infections, and vertigo.
departments.full_description: Comprehensive outpatient care for common and chronic ear infections, nasal polyps, allergic sinusitis, voice disorders, and tonsillitis.
departments.location: Wing C, Ground Floor, OPD Suites 110-114

services.name: Diagnostic Video Otoscopy & Nasal Endoscopy
services.description: High-definition endoscopic visualization for ear and nasal passages.

services.name: Audiometric Hearing Screening
services.description: Pure tone screening for hearing thresholds across age groups.

faqs.question: Is ear wax removal performed during the OPD visit?
faqs.answer: Yes, gentle microsuction or syringing is performed in the procedure room after clinical evaluation.

departments.name: Department of Dermatology & Skin Health
departments.short_description: Clinical diagnosis and care for allergic dermatoses, acne, fungal infections, and psoriasis.
departments.full_description: Specialized dermatological consultations providing evidence-based treatment for chronic skin allergies, hair fall evaluation, nail disorders, and eczema.

services.name: Clinical Dermoscopy & Skin Lesion Check
services.description: High-magnification surface microscopy for pigmented lesions and rashes.

services.name: Allergy & Eczema Medical Management
services.description: Targeted topical and systemic management of dermatitis.

faqs.question: Should I wash off facial ointments before coming to the appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, keeping the affected skin clean and free of cosmetics allows accurate dermoscopic visualization.
